text: The user is a 62-year-old man with the following health conditions: chronic kidney disease (stage 3b, not on dialysis), mild hypertension. Their dietary habits include: Tries to limit protein; Watches potassium and phosphorus; Adds little to no salt at table; Drinks moderate water; Eats few to no ready to eat meals; Takes prescribed supplements; Cooks most meals at home.

The user is a 54-year-old woman with the following health conditions: end-stage kidney disease on haemodialysis three times a week. Their dietary habits include: Restricts fluids; Limits potassium and phosphorus; Aims for higher protein on dialysis days; Adds little to no salt in preparation; Eats little to no processed food; Takes phosphate binders with meals.

The user is a 67-year-old man with the following health conditions: type 2 diabetes and diabetic kidney disease (stage 3). Their dietary habits include: Watches carbohydrate portions; Limits potassium; Moderates protein; Adds little to no salt at table; Checks blood glucose regularly; Eats few to no sugary drinks; Cooks most meals at home.

The user is a 58-year-old man with the following health conditions: compensated liver cirrhosis with early muscle wasting. Their dietary habits include: Poor appetite; Eats small frequent meals; Includes a late-evening snack; Drinks no alcohol; Struggles to meet protein targets; Eats little to no fast food; Often feels full quickly.

The user is a 45-year-old woman with the following health conditions: non-alcoholic fatty liver disease and overweight. Their dietary habits include: Trying to lose weight gradually; Limits sugary drinks and refined carbohydrates; Eats more vegetables; Reduces saturated fat; Drinks little to no alcohol; Walks most days; Eats few to no ready to eat meals.

The user is a 60-year-old woman with the following health conditions: colorectal cancer, currently undergoing chemotherapy, unintentional weight loss. Their dietary habits include: Frequent nausea; Altered taste; Eats small portions; Struggles with low appetite; Prefers bland soft foods; Drinks oral nutrition supplements; Eats few to no spicy foods.

The user is a 66-year-old man with the following health conditions: head and neck cancer with swallowing difficulty during radiotherapy. Their dietary habits include: Eats soft or pureed foods; Uses oral nutrition supplements; Finds dry foods hard to swallow; Adds sauces and gravies for moisture; Eats small frequent meals; Loses weight easily.

The user is a 52-year-old woman with the following health conditions: breast cancer survivor two years after treatment, wanting to eat well and manage cholesterol. Their dietary habits include: Eats plenty of vegetables and wholegrains; Limits red and processed meat; Chooses unsaturated fats; Drinks little to no alcohol; Maintains a healthy weight; Exercises regularly.

The user is a 29-year-old woman with the following health conditions: Crohn's disease, currently in a flare, recent weight loss. Their dietary habits include: Avoids high-fibre foods during flares; Eats small frequent meals; Limits dairy; Watches for trigger foods; Takes iron and vitamin supplements; Eats little to no raw vegetables.

The user is a 37-year-old man with the following health conditions: ulcerative colitis in remission. Their dietary habits include: Eats a varied balanced diet in remission; Gradually reintroduced fibre; Stays well hydrated; Monitors for symptom return; Limits alcohol; Takes a supplement when advised; Cooks most meals at home.

The user is a 49-year-old man with the following health conditions: chronic pancreatitis with fat malabsorption. Their dietary habits include: Eats a lower-fat diet; Takes enzyme replacement with meals; Eats small frequent meals; Drinks no alcohol; Watches for steatorrhoea; Takes fat-soluble vitamin supplements.

The user is a 41-year-old woman recovering from an episode of acute pancreatitis. Their dietary habits include: Reintroducing food gradually; Prefers low-fat meals; Eats small frequent portions; Drinks no alcohol; Avoids fried and greasy foods; Building back to a normal diet cautiously.

The user is a 43-year-old woman with the following health conditions: obesity, six months after bariatric (sleeve) surgery. Their dietary habits include: Eats very small portions; Prioritises protein at every meal; Takes lifelong multivitamin and mineral supplements; Separates fluids from meals; Eats few to no sugary foods; Chews food thoroughly.

The user is a 50-year-old man with the following health conditions: obesity with gastro-oesophageal reflux, wanting to lose weight. Their dietary habits include: Trying to reduce portion sizes; Avoids late heavy meals; Limits fatty and spicy foods; Cuts down on sugary drinks; Eats more vegetables; Walks daily.

The user is a 34-year-old woman with the following health conditions: newly diagnosed coeliac disease. Their dietary habits include: Strictly avoids gluten; Reads all food labels; Learning gluten-free substitutes; Eats little to no processed food; Worries about cross-contamination; Takes supplements for possible deficiencies.

The user is a 46-year-old man with the following health conditions: long-standing coeliac disease with persistent tiredness and low iron. Their dietary habits include: Follows a strict gluten-free diet; Checks for hidden gluten; Eats iron-rich foods; Takes iron and vitamin supplements; Eats little to no oats unless certified; Cooks most meals at home.

The user is a 68-year-old woman with the following health conditions: postmenopausal osteoporosis. Their dietary habits include: Tries to get enough calcium; Takes vitamin D supplements; Drinks lots of milk; Eats little or no fish; Walks daily; Adds little to no salt at table; Drinks alcohol less than average.

The user is a 72-year-old man with the following health conditions: osteoporosis after a wrist fracture. Their dietary habits include: Increasing calcium-rich foods; Takes vitamin D; Eats oily fish sometimes; Limits alcohol; Gave up smoking; Eats few to no ready to eat meals; Does resistance exercises.

The user is a 55-year-old man with the following health conditions: type 2 diabetes, high LDL cholesterol, overweight. Their dietary habits include: Watches carbohydrate portions; Chooses wholegrains; Limits saturated fat; Eats oily fish twice a week; Adds little to no salt at table; Eats few to no sugary drinks; Trying to lose weight.

The user is a 61-year-old woman with the following health conditions: type 2 diabetes and high blood pressure. Their dietary habits include: Follows a lower-salt diet; Watches carbohydrate intake; Eats more vegetables and fruit; Limits processed foods; Chooses low-fat dairy; Checks blood glucose; Walks most days.

The user is a 57-year-old man with the following health conditions: high cholesterol and a family history of heart disease. Their dietary habits include: Replaces saturated with unsaturated fats; Eats oily fish twice a week; Chooses wholegrains; Eats plenty of vegetables; Limits salt; Drinks alcohol less than average; Exercises regularly.

The user is a 48-year-old woman with the following health conditions: short bowel syndrome on home parenteral nutrition. Their dietary habits include: Eats small frequent oral meals; Manages high stoma output; Watches fluid and electrolyte balance; Limits high-sugar drinks; Takes prescribed micronutrients; Separates fluids from solids.

The user is a 79-year-old man with the following health conditions: type 2 diabetes, chronic kidney disease and malnutrition risk after a recent hospital stay. Their dietary habits include: Poor appetite; Low food intake; Struggles to meet protein and energy needs; Watches potassium; Eats small frequent meals; Needs help preparing food.

The user is an 83-year-old woman with the following health conditions: frailty, heart failure and unintentional weight loss. Their dietary habits include: Small appetite; Eats energy-dense small meals; Uses oral nutrition supplements; Limits added salt; Struggles with fatigue when cooking; Prefers soft foods; Eats little to no large meals.

The user is a 40-year-old man with the following health conditions: living with HIV, on antiretroviral therapy, maintaining weight. Their dietary habits include: Aims for adequate protein and energy; Practises careful food hygiene; Eats regular balanced meals; Takes a daily multivitamin; Eats little to no undercooked food; Manages occasional appetite changes.

The user is a 35-year-old woman with the following health conditions: HIV with recent unintentional weight loss and low appetite. Their dietary habits include: Eats small frequent nutrient-dense meals; Uses oral nutrition supplements; Practises strict food safety; Adds healthy fats to boost energy; Takes prescribed micronutrients; Manages nausea.
